release_notes:
UPDATE v1.1.6

BUG FIXES:
1. Fixed View Account batch selection — selecting multiple accounts and clicking "View Accounts" now correctly opens all selected accounts instead of only one
   - The context menu in Account Details dialog previously called view_single_account in a loop, which reset worker tracking and only launched the last account
   - Now passes the full batch to start_view_account_process, respecting the configured view_max_concurrent limit

ALL PREVIOUS FIXES INCLUDED:
- Telegram Bot & Remote Control fixes (v1.1.5)
- Status Reporting improvements (v1.1.5)
- Schedule Tab 500+ account reliability (v1.1.4)
- Auto-resume crash fix (v1.1.4)
- Schedule Tab UI & Worker improvements (v1.1.3)
- Immediate Stop Crash Fix (v1.1.2)
- Browser Count Decrement + User Config Respect (v1.1.1)
- 200+ Accounts Crash Fix, Batch Cleanup, Auto-Start, Resource Timeout (v1.1.0)

STABILITY:
- All previous stability improvements maintained
